data.name: AION Entertainment Suite

introduced.event_name: NCC June 1982 — colour graphics and mouse interaction

features: Mouse tutorials for pointing, clicking, dragging and both scrolling rollers
Keyboard alternatives, undo and clear rules
data.positioning: Mouse-focused recreational learning suite for the NCC 1982 mouse introduction; titles and release timing are deliberate alternate-history choices.
data.implementation: Use standard TUI/display and pointing APIs. Colour distinguishes suits and selections but patterns/labels preserve monochrome usability; games remain usable on older supported monitors. Do not require the new 64 KiB card.
data.delivery: Diskette; final packaging and price unspecified.
data.validation: Qualify puzzle validity/uniqueness, legal moves, deal generation, undo, input and resource budgets. Do not imply all randomly dealt card games are solvable.
